senses.gloss_en: Intensely preoccupied with or by a given topic or emotion; driven by a specified obsession
to daze, to benumb, to obnubilate
to darken, to obscure, to obfuscate
to become foggy or gloomy, to become obscured from sight
act or process of obfuscating, or obscuring the perception of something
the act or state of being obscured
